summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries. The parent guardian urges the FCC to protect E-Rate, emphasizing its role in providing reliable, affordable connectivity for students and libraries, and urges the Commission to reject proposals to sunset or eliminate the program and to preserve E-Rate's support for schools and libraries.

claims.requested_action: Reject proposals to sunset or eliminate E-Rate program
claims.argument: Rejecting sunset proposals would preserve the program's funding and prevent unnecessary cost reductions
claims.evidence_quote: I therefore respectfully urge the Commission to: Reject any proposal to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program; Reject proposals that would unnecessarily narrow E-Rate eligibility or restrict support based solely on geography or other criteria that would leave students without adequate support; Preserve support for the connectivity and internal network infrastructure schools need to provide reliable educational access; and Work with schools and other stakeholders to strengthen and modernize E-Rate rather than reduce its role in public education. E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education. As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible. Our students deserve access to the tools they need to learn and succeed regardless of where they live or their family’s financial circumstances. I urge the Commission to protect E-Rate and ensure that public schools can continue providing students with reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity. Thank you for considering my comments. Respectfully, Michelle Canyon Parent Gallup-Mckinley Co School Dist CHURCH ROCK
